title: Abyss Decorations
description: A bunch of decorations using the Polymer And filament mods.
body:
This is a datapack and a mod, It uses the Filament API to add fully custom blocks, some animated, Some interactive, all built for the abyss server now available to you the public!

We have so many things, all made by me, Daedreus. From the modeling to the texturing ~~minus some assets from minecraft itself~~ to the code, were done by me, by hand, this one pack has been in dev for months, and more things are going to be added! This is only the beginning.Please donate if you liked the pack. [kofi](https://ko-fi.com/xaeleus)

## So what is added?
So much.
lets start with 
### Clutter!
We have a few items made as semi jokes that are able to be placed on floors to clutter up a room
We have crystals 
Books with totally distinct logo on them
Papers!
flasks! ~~more shapes will be added when i stop being lazy~~
### Lamps lamps lamps!
God i spent so much time on these, we have lampposts of every wood type and theyre even togglable! 
the model was rushed and i will be revisiting it one day!
### stone!
We have 3 different new stone decorations.
Azalea Cobble, which is a mossy cobblestone with pink azalea flowers!
Blue Azalea Cobble, Which is the same But with blue flowers!
Small Stone brick, is a stone brick with a smaller cut in it!


### Once again Modrinths system is not allowing me to set my custom license it is [Draconis license 1.2](https://git.merith.xyz/packages/license/src/branch/main/Draconis/v1.2.md)
